concept.title: Dabu and other Rajasthani block prints (Bagru, Sanganeri)
concept.summary: Bagru and Sanganeri are other Rajasthani block prints distinct in look and method from Daboo.
concept.body_md: Bagru and Sanganeri are other Rajasthani block prints distinct in look and method from Daboo. [S19]

claims.text: Bagru and Sanganeri are other Rajasthani block prints distinct in look and method from Daboo.

evidence.quote: Daboo printing is often grouped together with other Rajasthani hand block prints like Sanganeri and Bagru, but is in fact quite distinct in terms of its look and method.

removal_reason: Lead ruling 2026-11-08 (DR-131 follow-up): the only source, S19, is an unattributed Utsavpedia page; no attributed source among the 24 archived Dabu sources or a web search states that Dabu printing is distinct from both Bagru and Sanganeri prints, so the comparison and its link are removed rather than approved.
